{{Otheruses|Imperial Complex}}
The '''Imperial Complex''' was an area on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that included the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], [[Darth Vader's Palace|Darth Vader's castle]], the old [[Senate Hall]], offices of the most important ministries and departments, and wealthy non-governmental residences, such as [[Xizor's Palace]].<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Benedict Vidkun]] worked in the [[Sewers of Coruscant]] under the Complex.<ref name="sotes" />
